Add Custom Icon or Awesome Markers (add_markers, make_icon, make_awesome_icon)

Source: R/map.R
add_markers.Rd

Drop-in GPU/Canvas equivalents of leaflet::addMarkers(), leaflet::makeIcon(), and leaflet::makeAwesomeIcon(). Supports per-feature SVG/PNG icon URLs as well as colored pin/badge markers.

Configures how glmap balances visual fidelity and 60 FPS GPU throughput across the three marker rendering engines:

  1. WebGL2 Texture Atlas ("atlas"): Packs all unique SVG/PNG icons into a single GPU sprite sheet texture and renders 100k+ custom icons in 1 gl.POINTS draw call.

  2. Screen-Space Grid Clustering ("cluster"): Groups nearby markers into interactive count badges (< 10, < 100, 100+) that zoom into cluster bounds on click and render unclustered singletons via the GPU Texture Atlas.

  3. Zoom-Level Level-of-Detail Hybrid ("lod"): Renders crisp GPU SDF points at overview zoom levels and smoothly cross-fades into full custom SVG/PNG Texture Atlas icons as you zoom in across lod_zoom.

Usage

add_markers(
  map,
  data = NULL,
  lng = NULL,
  lat = NULL,
  icon = NULL,
  popup = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  clusterOptions = NULL,
  render_mode = "auto",
  lod_zoom = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  ...
)

make_icon(
  iconUrl = NULL,
  iconRetinaUrl = NULL,
  iconWidth = 28,
  iconHeight = 28,
  iconAnchorX = NULL,
  iconAnchorY = NULL,
  shadowUrl = NULL,
  shadowRetinaUrl = NULL,
  shadowWidth = NULL,
  shadowHeight = NULL,
  shadowAnchorX = NULL,
  shadowAnchorY = NULL,
  popupAnchorX = NULL,
  popupAnchorY = NULL,
  className = NULL
)

icons(
  iconUrl = NULL,
  iconRetinaUrl = NULL,
  iconWidth = 28,
  iconHeight = 28,
  iconAnchorX = NULL,
  iconAnchorY = NULL,
  shadowUrl = NULL,
  shadowRetinaUrl = NULL,
  shadowWidth = NULL,
  shadowHeight = NULL,
  shadowAnchorX = NULL,
  shadowAnchorY = NULL,
  popupAnchorX = NULL,
  popupAnchorY = NULL,
  className = NULL
)

icon_list(...)

make_awesome_icon(
  icon = "circle",
  library = "fa",
  markerColor = "blue",
  iconColor = "#ffffff",
  spin = FALSE,
  extraClasses = NULL,
  squareMarker = FALSE,
  iconRotate = 0,
  fontFamily = "monospace",
  text = NULL
)

awesome_icons(
  icon = "circle",
  library = "fa",
  markerColor = "blue",
  iconColor = "#ffffff",
  spin = FALSE,
  extraClasses = NULL,
  squareMarker = FALSE,
  iconRotate = 0,
  fontFamily = "monospace",
  text = NULL
)

awesome_icon_list(...)

marker_cluster_options(
  showCoverageOnHover = TRUE,
  zoomToBoundsOnClick = TRUE,
  spiderfyOnMaxZoom = TRUE,
  disableClusteringAtZoom = 21,
  maxClusterRadius = 65,
  freezeAtZoom = FALSE
)

icon_render_options(
  mode = c("auto", "atlas", "cluster", "lod", "points"),
  lod_zoom = NULL,
  atlas_cell_px = 64L,
  allow_ui_switcher = TRUE
)

Arguments

map

A glmap widget or glmap_proxy.

data

An sf, sfc, or data.frame object.

lng

Optional alias for lon (leaflet compatibility).

lat

Optional latitude column name or formula (~lat) for data.frame.

icon

Optional icon name from FontAwesome/Ionicons/Bootstrap (leaflet compatibility).

popup

Optional formula (~name), column name, or character vector for click/hover tooltips.

label

Alias for popup.

group

Layer group name shown in the interactive layer switcher.

clusterOptions

Optional clustering specification (leaflet::markerClusterOptions() or marker_cluster_options() compatibility).

render_mode

Rendering strategy for markers/icons: "auto" (default; dynamically combines clustering, zoom-level LOD cross-fade, and WebGL2 Texture Atlas sprites based on feature count and clusterOptions), "cluster" (screen-space clustering + GPU singleton sprites), "lod" (zoom-level Level-of-Detail cross-fade from GPU SDF points at overview zooms to full WebGL2 Texture Atlas sprites when zoomed in), "atlas" (always render 100% of custom icons via the WebGL2 Texture Atlas sprite shader in 1 GPU draw call), or "points" (pure GPU SDF circles). Can also be an icon_render_options() object.

lod_zoom

Numeric zoom threshold (e.g. 10) or 2-element cross-fade range c(9, 11). If NULL, computed dynamically from feature count (<= 2,500: c(0, 0) always icons; 2,501-15,000: c(8.5, 10.5); > 15,000: c(10.0, 12.0)).

id

Layer ID string.

...

Additional arguments passed to add_points().

iconUrl

URL or relative path (e.g. inside Shiny www/) to an SVG or PNG icon.

iconRetinaUrl

Optional retina URL (leaflet compatibility).

iconWidth, iconHeight

Icon dimensions in pixels (default 28).

iconAnchorX, iconAnchorY

Optional anchor coordinates (leaflet compatibility).

shadowUrl, shadowRetinaUrl, shadowWidth, shadowHeight, shadowAnchorX, shadowAnchorY

Optional shadow parameters (leaflet compatibility).

popupAnchorX, popupAnchorY

Optional popup anchor coordinates (leaflet compatibility).

className

Optional CSS class (leaflet compatibility).

library

Optional icon library ("fa", "ion", "glyphicon").

markerColor

Marker pin color (e.g., "red", "blue", "orange", "green", "purple").

iconColor

Inner glyph color (default "#ffffff").

spin, extraClasses, squareMarker, iconRotate, fontFamily

Optional parameters kept for leaflet::makeAwesomeIcon() compatibility.

text

Optional short symbol or glyph text inside the awesome marker pin.

showCoverageOnHover

Logical; highlight cluster bounds on hover.

zoomToBoundsOnClick

Logical; zoom to cluster bounds when clicked (default TRUE).

spiderfyOnMaxZoom

Logical; expand overlapping points at max zoom.

disableClusteringAtZoom

Numeric zoom level at or above which individual markers/icons are shown directly (default 15).

maxClusterRadius

Maximum radius in pixels that a cluster will cover (default 65).

freezeAtZoom

Optional zoom level to freeze clusters.

mode

Strategy name: "auto" (default; dynamically selects based on clusterOptions and feature count n), "atlas", "cluster", "lod", or "points".

atlas_cell_px

Resolution in pixels of each sprite slot in the GPU Texture Atlas (default 64L).

allow_ui_switcher

Logical; if TRUE (default), exposes a compact mode selector in the map's layer control so users can switch between Auto, Cluster, LOD, and GPU Atlas live.
